column1: # The link-profile bench's floors (tests/e2e.rs, bench_link_profiles), as
# CI's speed regression job enforces them (.github/workflows/speed.yml):
# profile, least Mbit/s, most per cent of the file sent again.
# Wide on purpose: they catch a collapse — the congestion control taking
# random loss for a policer, pacing gone, the file sent twice — not a few
# per cent, which a shared runner's speed varies by more. The release build
# CI runs reaches 300 to 650 Mbit/s on the clean profile, and a transfer of
# a second or two is mostly its start: what the slow start sends beyond the
# test proxy's buffers is resent (8 per cent clean on CI, 6 at 0.1 per cent
# loss, 17 at 5 per cent, here). Raise them as CI's own numbers come in.
